items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And you played that with Papa Lane's groups? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: And, oh yeah, Elaine was a catarct, see, he sold the band, oh yeah. Yeah. A 10-piece band, see. And the son of a guy, we get in there and open up with, oh, Mr. Dream Man, please let me dream some more. And she says, the guy's getting nailed on the cross. Oh! Oh! The man, the man threw the band, they know, they want some beautiful music. Yeah, they hired Papa Lane's band. Oh! Almost a dream man.
Did you finish the, they let you finish the... No! They, out we went.
